title: CHESS: Contextual Harnessing for Efficient SQL Synthesis
venue: arXiv; authors' lab lists ICML 2025 MAS workshop
status: preprint v3 reviewed; workshop listing verified at authors' lab, not labeled ICML main conference
evidence_level: primary architecture and ablations; moderate-to-high for transferable components
read_status: CoChat abstract_only; Firecrawl retrieved public arXiv v3 HTML (119482 chars); sections 3.1-3.3, 4.2.3, limitations and A.1-A.3 read
claim_supported: Entity/catalog retrieval, key-preserving schema filtering, one-candidate low-compute configuration and amortized value indexing reduce context work. Large-schema experiment combines databases.
limitations: Original open-model configuration includes Llama3-70B and neural embeddings, not a legal <=15B graph. Empty-output-repair heuristic is inappropriate for DataMate. Natural-language unit tests are not a proof of semantic correctness.
feature_transfer: keys and dependency closure retained during schema pruning
sections_read: LSH/value lookup and linking-key retention appendices

title: Spider 2.0: Evaluating Language Models on Real-World Enterprise Text-to-SQL Workflows
evidence_level: primary enterprise benchmark/error analysis; high for failure modes, not direct DataMate effect sizes
read_status: CoChat abstract_only/analysis-only status; public primary v2 HTML retrieved through Firecrawl; task/evaluation/results/error analysis and C.1 harness read; official ICLR PDF venue cross-check
claim_supported: Enterprise QA needs metadata/document grounding and iterative execution; schema linking, analysis planning and joins remain substantial failure categories. Explicit tool actions separate catalog inspection from execution.
limitations: Broader cloud/DBT workloads than DataMate. Main/appendix decoding settings differ. Does not prove scores or hardware performance under DataMate constraints.

title: SheetCopilot: Bringing Software Productivity to the Next Level through Large Language Models
evidence_level: primary peer-reviewed/workshop research; transfer limitations apply
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated at ~50k characters; primary NeurIPS page verified
claim_supported: Spreadsheet API abstraction plus state-machine observation/planning/revision is prior art; 221 tasks cover sheet manipulation rather than only QA.
limitations: GUI/software control output differs from DataMate typed answers; atomic actions do not by themselves solve business semantics.

title: Data Interpreter: An LLM Agent For Data Science
evidence_level: primary peer-reviewed/workshop research; transfer limitations apply
read_status: CoChat full_text of arXiv v4 (truncated); official ACL 2025 record/PDF abstract verified; version differences noted
claim_supported: Hierarchical task/action graphs with progressive execution, verification and replanning are established prior art. Intermediate step verification and context management are stronger foundations than free-form multi-agent discussion.
limitations: Benefits depend on model/context capacity: arXiv table reports degradation for GPT-4-0613 but improvement for GPT-4o. Data-science benchmarks do not certify DataMate gains.

title: ReAcTable: Enhancing ReAct for Table Question Answering
evidence_level: primary peer-reviewed/workshop research; transfer limitations apply
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated at ~50k characters; final PVLDB paper metadata verified
claim_supported: Iterative SQL/Python transformations, intermediate table representations and execution-based selection already exist for table QA; reported WikiTQ result is 68.0%.
limitations: Paper formulation focuses single-table TQA and mostly public benchmark tables; multi-file joins and missing-evidence refusal remain gaps.

title: EntSQL: A Benchmark for Grounding Text-to-SQL in Long-Context Enterprise Knowledge
evidence_level: primary preprint; supporting, not definitive
read_status: CoChat full_text complete; primary arXiv metadata verified
claim_supported: 1,066 bilingual enterprise examples test long business-document grounding. Localized evidence performs better than full documents, but substantial rule-composition failure remains. Error analysis of one model identifies filters/scope as major failures.
limitations: Single enterprise, five domains; English-translated main evaluation; one-model failure taxonomy; no Vietnamese results. Do not transfer benchmark numbers to DataMate.

title: ProSPy: A Profiling-Driven SQL-Python Agentic Framework for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
evidence_level: primary preprint; supporting, not definitive
read_status: CoChat full_text complete; primary arXiv metadata verified
claim_supported: Profiling once per database, progressive schema pruning, dimensions/metrics/conditions DSL, SQL views and Python analysis are existing architecture. Reported ablations support profiling/DSL/Python on a small Spider2-Snow subset.
limitations: Intermediate-view errors propagate; cloud/enterprise schemas differ from messy files. Long schema-linking latency means direct adoption may miss competition budget.

title: Binding Language Models in Symbolic Languages
evidence_level: primary peer-reviewed research
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated; official OpenReview PDF verified
claim_supported: Training-free neuro-symbolic executable programs and binding LM functions into SQL/Python already exist; explicit programs aid debugging.
limitations: LM-returned semantic values are not guaranteed correct and may use outside knowledge. In DataMate, use only authorized data/rulebook; do not infer missing business facts.

title: TrustSQL: Benchmarking Text-to-SQL Reliability with Penalty-Based Scoring
status: preprint; arXiv v6 under review; CoChat search non-preprint flag not accepted
evidence_level: primary empirical benchmark; moderate
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated at 50000 chars; primary arXiv v6 cross-check
claim_supported: Reliable text-to-SQL combines feasibility detection, SQL-error detection and abstention; penalty-based scoring makes confident errors expensive.
limitations: Not Vietnamese messy workbook QA; does not establish DataMate performance. Older title in CoChat search differs from v6.

title: Reliable Text-to-SQL with Adaptive Abstention
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data / SIGMOD 2025
evidence_level: primary empirical and theoretical methods; high for overlap
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated; DOI publisher abstract cross-check
claim_supported: Schema-linking uncertainty and conformal branching can trigger abstention or human intervention.
limitations: Human interaction and hidden-layer access are not automatically available/allowed in DataMate; guarantees do not transfer under domain shift.

title: Semantic Evaluation for Text-to-SQL with Distilled Test Suites
evidence_level: primary evaluation method; high
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated; ACL Anthology cross-check
claim_supported: Single-database denotation agreement can be a false positive; distilled diverse database suites approximate semantic equivalence.
limitations: Evaluation uses gold SQL, unavailable for private inference. Does not remove need for independent semantic oracle.

title: Dr.Spider: A Diagnostic Evaluation Benchmark towards Text-to-SQL Robustness
evidence_level: primary robustness benchmark; high
read_status: CoChat full_text; official ICLR/OpenReview PDF identified
claim_supported: Schema/content/question perturbations expose robustness failures obscured by standard development accuracy.
limitations: Older model generations; does not directly predict effect sizes for the chosen legal 14B model.

title: TrustDABench: Benchmarking Reliability and Robustness of LLMs for Structured Data Analysis
evidence_level: primary empirical benchmark; moderate
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated; primary HTML abstract/methods cross-check
claim_supported: CSV/spreadsheet agents fail at missing/conflicting evidence and representation changes; 7 reliability plus 12 robustness operators provide useful stress-test families.
limitations: Single recent benchmark; LLM-assisted construction and judging; different tasks/languages/models; no independent replication found.

title: PremiseSQL: Evaluating Premise Critique and Abstention in Text-to-SQL Systems
evidence_level: primary empirical benchmark; moderate
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated; primary HTML taxonomy/methods cross-check
claim_supported: Critique prompts can increase detection of flawed premises while falsely rejecting valid paired originals.
limitations: Benchmark taxonomy includes SQL-expressibility limits that do not apply to SQL+Python DataMate agents; not an unanswerability oracle.

title: DPC: Training-Free Text-to-SQL Candidate Selection via Dual-Paradigm Consistency
evidence_level: primary method and empirical evaluation; high for novelty overlap
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated; ACL primary page cross-check
claim_supported: Minimal Distinguishing Databases via SLICER/TESTER agents plus SQL/Python consistency already implement much of the generic witness-verifier idea.
limitations: Python is a proxy reference and can share semantic bias. Gains cannot be transferred to DataMate or <=15B offline models without experiment.

title: Automated Validating and Fixing of Text-to-SQL Translation with Execution Consistency
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data / SIGMOD 2025
evidence_level: primary method; high for novelty overlap
read_status: CoChat abstract_only; primary author-PDF search excerpts retrieved (including unrealistic counterexamples), direct PDF open timed out; no complete PDF read claimed
claim_supported: SQLDriller generates candidate SQLs and obtains counterexample DBs with an equivalence checker, then validates NL/SQL consistency; unrealistic fixtures are a documented concern.
limitations: Training-dataset validation focus; no gold correctness proof from a candidate disagreement alone; no DataMate gain claim.

title: SPOTIT+: Verification-based Text-to-SQL Evaluation with Database Constraints
status: preprint v3, 2026-05-11; unverified venue template in PDF not treated as publication evidence
evidence_level: primary formal-method tool and experiment; moderate
read_status: CoChat full_text untruncated; primary arXiv metadata cross-check
claim_supported: Bounded equivalence checking can use mined/validated domain constraints to produce realistic counterexamples; constraint extraction is best-effort.
limitations: Requires gold/reference query for evaluation; bounded verification is not global SQL equivalence; broad SQL equivalence is undecidable.

title: SQL's Three-Valued Logic and Certain Answers
venue: ICDT 2015; expanded journal version TODS 2016 DOI 10.1145/2877206
evidence_level: primary theoretical foundation; high
read_status: CoChat full_text untruncated but returned ICDT 2015 precursor when queried by TODS DOI; canonicalized to actually read version
claim_supported: Certain answers are invariant over admitted completions; SQL's handling of unknown/false can yield false positives; tractable sound approximations require explicit semantics.
limitations: Cannot claim an all-SQL all-worlds solver. Aggregates, ambiguity and data completeness require separately stated fragments and assumptions.

title: Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable, Resource-Aware Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents
venue: arXiv; manuscript states NeurIPS 2026 resource-aware agentic AI workshop
status: preprint, 2026-10-02; workshop acceptance not independently established here
evidence_level: primary empirical method; moderate
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated; arXiv primary abstract cross-check
claim_supported: Sentinel monitors answerability and correctness at pre-run, mid-run and delivery gates, uses Chow's rule and can reduce wasted trajectories.
limitations: Clinical EHRSQL domain and label-trained classifiers; correctness/answerability gates are existing art. Extra neural classifier would count toward DataMate's aggregate parameter cap.

title: Never the Number: Structural Abstention for AI Systems Whose Answers Are Consumed as Fact
evidence_level: conceptual prior art; low for empirical efficacy
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated; primary arXiv disclosure cross-check
claim_supported: Trusted deterministic kernel plus generative shell and structural abstention are explicitly proposed; bounded question coverage trades off reliability.
limitations: Report explicitly excludes code, real schemas, datasets and quantitative performance metrics; human confirmation assumption does not fit non-interactive evaluation.

title: What Predicts Correctness in Text-to-SQL? A Selective-Prediction Study
evidence_level: primary limited empirical study; low-to-moderate
read_status: CoChat full_text untruncated; primary arXiv cross-check
claim_supported: In its experiments, statistical self-consistency is weaker than reasoning verifiers and small trained verifiers transfer poorly across schemas.
limitations: Limited datasets/generators; placeholder affiliation and an incorrect RTS author citation in references. Not independently replicated; do not build a quantitative promise on this paper.

title: A Pilot Study of Text-to-SQL Semantic Parsing for Vietnamese
evidence_level: primary historical Vietnamese benchmark
read_status: CoChat full_text available; task construction, methods, results and selected error analysis read
claim_supported: ViText2SQL translates clean Spider questions and schema into Vietnamese; schema/value linking and segmentation affect historical parsers. The clean benchmark does not directly represent DataMate's raw files, colloquial questions and rulebook.
limitations: 2020 recurrent parsers and translated clean databases; cannot extrapolate gains to modern LLM agents.

title: VLSP 2025 Shared Task: Vietnamese Temporal Question Answering (TemporalQA)
venue: VNU Journal of Science: Computer Science and Communication Engineering 42(3):34–53
evidence_level: primary Vietnamese shared-task report
read_status: CoChat full_text returned, truncated; introduction, task definitions, evaluation and data construction read
claim_supported: Vietnamese date arithmetic and contextual duration are distinct tasks; parsing reference dates and mixed-unit intervals needs separate validation.
limitations: Controlled date-arithmetic and contextual duration tasks, not proof of messy-file, Vietnamese lunar-calendar or business-calendar correctness. Semantic Scholar unavailable on the discovery query.

title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
read_status: CoChat indexed full text truncated to ~50,000 characters; actual methods/evaluation and limitations read, primary arXiv HTML/metadata cross-checked
status: ICLR 2026 Oral; primary arXiv accepted-paper version read
claim_supported: Reflective mutation optimizes frozen-model system prompts using execution/evaluation traces, minibatch screening and instance-wise Pareto candidate selection. Includes Qwen3-8B experiments with train/selection/test separation.
limitations: Not a proof of unbounded recursive improvement; performance is task/model-dependent and merge can hurt. Repeated selection validation still invites adaptive overfit. Published gains are not DataMate PA gains.
feature_transfer: Use development-time prompt optimization on train-derived feedback with a fixed execution model, official typed-answer reward, separate candidate-selection businesses and an untouched audit set. No test-derived prompt updates.

title: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models
read_status: CoChat indexed full text truncated to ~50,000 characters; actual methods/evaluation and limitations read, primary arXiv HTML/metadata cross-checked
status: ICLR 2026; primary arXiv accepted-paper version read
claim_supported: Generator/Reflector/Curator roles maintain itemized context bullets with local delta updates, useful/harmful counters and deterministic merges; avoids monolithic context collapse.
limitations: Main backend is DeepSeek-V3.1-671B, far above DataMate cap; other reported transfer models are also large. Poor feedback can pollute the playbook; longer context adds latency and does not help every task.
feature_transfer: Maintain offline rule-grounded lessons with scope, evidence, preconditions and regression cases; retrieve a bounded subset. Freeze learned playbook before test; deterministic lexical dedup/retrieval avoids extra inference models.

title: AFlow: Automating Agentic Workflow Generation
read_status: CoChat abstract_only; primary arXiv HTML Sections 3-5 and algorithm/evaluation read; official OpenReview PDF venue verified
status: ICLR 2025 conference paper; official OpenReview PDF verified
claim_supported: Searches code-represented workflows using a MCTS variant over prompts/edges and fixed operators, with repeated execution feedback. Actual search fixes model, temperature and format to reduce the space.
limitations: Uses Claude-3.5-Sonnet optimizer and API-based executors; metrics mix solve-rate/pass@1/F1 and differ from PA. Candidate evaluation is costly; workflows are model-dependent. Do not copy the paper's large search directly.
feature_transfer: Search a very small approved workflow grammar offline: profile/plan/execute/verify/decide with capped retries. Lock model and total budget; compare against simpler manual routing.

title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
read_status: CoChat indexed full text truncated to ~50,000 characters; actual methods/evaluation and limitations read, primary arXiv HTML/metadata cross-checked
status: ICLR 2026 Poster listed in official OpenReview author search; primary arXiv manuscript used
claim_supported: Frozen-model coding agents self-modify their own harness repositories, with an archive enabling diverse stepping-stone lineages and staged empirical benchmark evaluation. The outer archive/selection mechanism itself remains fixed.
limitations: Empirical benchmark improvement replaces formal proof. Full runs use Claude-3.5-Sonnet/o3-mini and 80 iterations; coding-benchmark gains do not establish tabular-QA gains or unlimited RSI.
feature_transfer: Keep parented candidate snapshots and a few diverse low-cost/high-accuracy variants as development artifacts. Restrict editable surfaces; promote only after independent evaluator gates; freeze one selected harness for inference.

title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
read_status: CoChat indexed full text truncated to ~50,000 characters; actual methods/evaluation and limitations read, primary arXiv HTML/metadata cross-checked
status: Google DeepMind white paper / arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed status not established here
claim_supported: Evolutionary code search uses a user-provided automatic evaluator, explicit editable blocks, candidate database, evaluation cascades and asynchronous proposal/evaluation. Algorithms must be machine-gradeable.
limitations: Relies on Gemini Flash/Pro and potentially substantial parallel compute. Correctness guarantees in some mathematical applications come from task-specific validators, not from evolution itself. An incomplete QA oracle remains incomplete.
feature_transfer: Borrow cheap-to-expensive evaluation cascades and immutable exact scorers. Evolve bounded parser/serializer/tool components offline; final business answers always come from original supplied files.

title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
read_status: CoChat indexed full text truncated to ~50,000 characters; actual methods/evaluation and limitations read, primary arXiv HTML/metadata cross-checked
status: arXiv preprint; peer review not confirmed
claim_supported: Makes harness components file-editable, traces navigable in layered reports, and edits falsifiable through change manifests. Immutable verifier/model configuration constrain search; evaluated frozen transfer and component ablations.
limitations: One ten-iteration campaign uses GPT-5.4 and ~32 hours. Components interact non-additively; prompt-only swap regresses and self-predicted regression recall is low. Cross-benchmark gain is modest and some repositories regress.
feature_transfer: Use per-change hypothesis manifests, source evidence links, immutable scorer/config, full regression checks and rollback. Trust measured outcomes over an editing agent's self-attribution.

title: Reflexion: language agents with verbal reinforcement learning
read_status: CoChat indexed full text truncated to ~50,000 characters; actual methods/evaluation and limitations read, primary arXiv HTML/metadata cross-checked
status: NeurIPS 2023 proceedings record found through CoChat; primary arXiv methods/evaluation read
claim_supported: Actor/evaluator/reflection roles store textual lessons across attempts without weight updates. Programming analysis shows wrong self-generated tests can falsely certify wrong code or reject correct code; external feedback matters.
limitations: Improvement depends on evaluator quality and search diversity; reflection can get stuck. Historical coding scores are not DataMate results. Self-generated tests do not establish semantic correctness.
feature_transfer: Permit one bounded retry after a concrete execution, type, rule, provenance or witness failure. Store only validated development lessons; never equate self-confidence or test agreement with a business-answer oracle.

title: Recursive Language Models
status: preprint version reviewed; no proceedings publication assumed from author-blog acceptance claim
evidence_level: primary empirical architecture; moderate evidence for transfer to legal small models
read_status: CoChat full_text truncated near 50000 chars; actual v3 methods/evaluation and small-model training passages read; primary v3 HTML/abstract cross-check
claim_supported: Externalize the input in a persistent REPL and use programmatic inspections/semantic subcalls. Depth-zero sometimes beats recursive variants; small-model training matters.
limitations: Benchmarks are not Vietnamese CSV/XLSX/SQLite QA. Main frontier model configurations cannot meet <=15B. Comparable token cost is not a six-hour wall-clock guarantee. Small checkpoint release/quality requires separate audit.

title: Executable Code Actions Elicit Better LLM Agents

claim_supported: Executable code composes control/data flow and supports execution-feedback repair; tool composition was compared across 17 models.
limitations: API/tool success and completion are not exact business-answer correctness. No DataMate-specific result. Code flexibility does not resolve missing data or semantic assumptions.
